# KM-124 — Delete old agent stacks, suites, scripts and preview runner

**Lane:** platform · **Complexity:** 2 · **Model:** codex · **Depends on:** KM-101, KM-102, KM-103, KM-123 · **Serializes with:** none (its dependencies already order every shared file)
**Plan context (pinned):** [M1 plan](https://github.com/aiur-team/khala/blob/reset/m1-external-plan/docs/plans/2026-10-01-002-refactor-external-m1-thin-path-plan.md) · [contracts](https://github.com/aiur-team/khala/blob/reset/m1-external-plan/docs/build/m1/contracts.md) · [roster and graph](https://github.com/aiur-team/khala/blob/reset/m1-external-plan/docs/build/m1/roster.md)
**Exclusive write surfaces:** every path in the Delete list below; root `package.json` (scripts), `pnpm-lock.yaml`, `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, `scripts/check-boundaries.mjs`, `scripts/check-boundaries.test.mjs`, `scripts/check-terminology.mjs`, `scripts/check-terminology.test.mjs`, `scripts/dist-exports.test.mjs`, `apps/web/src/landing/agent-instructions.test.ts`

## Outcome

A pure deletion PR (about 700 files). It removes the old connector, policy, harness, CLI, skill and plugin packages, the internal/agent test suites and runners, the agent-only scripts, the disposable preview runner and the npm release workflow. It does not rename the new agent package: `packages/agent` stays `@khala/agent` (contracts C1, reconciliation A8). It also edits CI, the root scripts and the repo checks so that `pnpm install`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm lint`, `pnpm test` and `pnpm build` pass, and the human browser spec still passes on the KM-101 stack.

## Context and evidence

- Plan U7; R13 ("Code that M1 does not use is deleted, not hidden"); Definition of Done bullet 2. Deletion order: U4 (KM-102), U5 (KM-120) and U6 (KM-123) come before U7 (here), and U8 (KM-125) comes after.
- Nothing kept depends on the deleted packages at `5db209cc`:
  - `apps/control` depends only on `@khala/contracts` and `@khala/messaging`;
  - `apps/web` depends only on those two and `@aiur/components`;
  - `packages/contracts` has no workspace dependencies;
  - `packages/messaging` depends only on contracts (`*/package.json`).
- `infra/preview/` is replaced by `infra/local/` (KM-101). `infra/preview/hosted-dex/` served only the disposable KHA-134 hosted preview (`infra/preview/hosted.md:23-29`), not production.

## Scope

Delete the listed paths, then make the remaining repo green with the listed edits. No behavior change in kept code.

## Non-goals

- Control routes and files: already removed by **KM-123**. If any remain, stop (see Risks).
- Fixing unrelated CI failures on `main`: **KM-160**.

## Contract and invariants

Quoted from contracts.md **C1**:

> Deleted by KM-124: `apps/connector`, `packages/{connector,policy,agent-skill,agent-cli,harnesses,claude-plugin}`.

> | `@khala/agent` | `packages/agent` (new) | The agent MCP server, hooks, wakers, Claude plugin files and Codex config files. Bin `khala`. Runs from TypeScript source via `tsx` (hook scripts too) |

> The agent package is `@khala/agent` for all of M1; nothing renames it (KM-124 included) and npm publishing is deferred (D7).

Invariants:
- `packages/agent/package.json` is untouched by this PR and still named `@khala/agent`.
- After this PR, no workspace package is named `@aiur/khala`. At `5db209cc` the only one is `packages/agent-cli/package.json:2`, which this PR deletes.
- No kept test is weakened. A test may be removed only when every module it exercises is in the Delete list, and each removal is named in the PR body.
- `deletion-guard` (`.github/workflows/deletion-guard.yml:34-54`) requires an APPROVED review from a repository admin on the exact head SHA. The reviewer handles this. Any push after approval makes it stale, so push the final head once, then ask for review.

### Worked example

Root `scripts` after this PR (KM-101 and KM-102 already applied):

```json
"typecheck": "pnpm -r typecheck",
"lint": "eslint . && pnpm check:boundaries && pnpm check:terminology",
"check:boundaries": "node scripts/check-boundaries.mjs",
"check:terminology": "node scripts/check-terminology.mjs",
"test": "node --test scripts/*.test.mjs && node --test 'infra/**/*.test.ts' 'infra/local/*.test.mjs' && pnpm -r test",
"test:integration": "playwright test --config tests/integration/playwright.config.ts",
"build": "pnpm check:boundaries && pnpm -r build",
"test:browser": "pnpm -r --if-present test:browser",
"stack:up": "...", "stack:down": "...", "stack:logs": "...", "stack:status": "..."
```

### Steps

1. Preconditions. Stop if any check fails.
   1. `test -d infra/local && ! grep -rn "infra/preview" infra/local package.json` (KM-101 landed).
   2. `test -d packages/agent` and `node -p "require('./packages/agent/package.json').name"` prints `@khala/agent` (KM-103 landed; the name is permanent for M1).
   3. `! grep -n "vite.internal" apps/web/package.json` (KM-102 landed).
   4. `test ! -d apps/control/src/agent-bootstrap` (KM-123 landed).
   5. `grep -rlE "@khala/(connector|policy|harnesses|agent-skill|claude-plugin|connector-app)|packages/agent-cli|apps/connector" packages/agent apps/web/src apps/control/src packages/contracts packages/messaging | grep -v '^apps/web/src/landing/agent-instructions.test.ts$'` prints nothing. (That one test file is expected to match; Step 9 edits it. `README.md` files under these trees may also match; they are prose, and a match there is not a stop — list them in the PR body for KM-153/KM-125.)
2. Run every `git rm -r` in the Delete list. Do **not** rename `packages/agent` or edit any `@khala/agent` reference.
3. Root `package.json`:
   - delete the eight scripts named above;
   - set `"test"` as in the worked example. Keep whatever `infra/local` glob KM-101 added.
4. `.github/workflows/ci.yml`:
   - delete the `Disposable bootstrap and Synapse recovery fixture` step (both lines);
   - rename `Install Chromium for connector and browser tests` to `Install Chromium for browser tests`.
5. `scripts/check-boundaries.mjs`:
   1. Remove the connector substrate exception, so `composition` is `origin.includes('/composition/')`.
   2. Remove `installedConnectorEntry`; the app rule becomes `if (owner !== destination && destination.startsWith('apps/')) errors.add(...)`.
   3. Remove `policy` and its two rules, so `pure` is `browser || owner === 'packages/contracts'`.
   4. Change the browser rule regex to `/^(?:apps\/control|packages\/agent)\//`, keeping the message `browser reaches owner/server code`.
   5. Keep the generic workspace-name resolution (`:44-52`) and `serverDependencies` (`:9`). (At `5db209cc` there is no `@aiur/khala`-specific rule in this file.)
6. `scripts/check-boundaries.test.mjs`:
   1. Delete the tests `only the installed CLI entry may import the connector production composition`, `connector substrate adapters compose package ports while other modules cannot` and `policy rejects external I/O and computed imports`.
   2. Rewrite three tests on `packages/agent`:
      - **TS path aliases**: `apps/web/tsconfig.json` paths `{'@owner/*': ['packages/agent/src/*']}`; `apps/web/src/chat.ts` contains `import('@owner/state');`; `packages/agent/src/state.ts`; expect `browser reaches owner/server`.
      - **workspace subpath exports**: `apps/web/src/chat.ts` contains `import '@khala/agent/state';`; `packages/agent/package.json` is `{ name: '@khala/agent', exports: { './*': './src/*.ts' } }`; expect `browser reaches owner/server`.
      - **source-conditioned exports**: `packages/messaging/src/x.ts` contains `import '@khala/agent/client';`; `packages/agent/package.json` is `{ name: '@khala/agent', exports: { './*': { 'khala-source': './src/*.ts' } } }`; `packages/agent/src/client.ts`; expect `cross-component implementation requires a composition root` and no `unresolved workspace`. Rename the test to `source-conditioned exports of the agent package resolve before install`.
7. `scripts/check-terminology.mjs:139`: replace `'packages/agent-cli/src'` with `'packages/agent/src'`. In `scripts/check-terminology.test.mjs:32,72,93`, replace `packages/agent-cli/src/` with `packages/agent/src/`.
8. `scripts/dist-exports.test.mjs`: delete the `packages/harnesses` and `packages/policy` entries from `GUARDED`.
9. `apps/web/src/landing/agent-instructions.test.ts`: delete the second `it(...)` block (`:30-60`), whose subject files are deleted. Keep the first block unchanged. This is the only edit KM-124 makes to the file; KM-153 (which runs after this ticket) owns it from then on and adds the M1 replacement.
10. `pnpm install`, and commit `pnpm-lock.yaml`.
11. Run the Verification block. Fix only breakages caused by this deletion. Anything else red goes in the PR body for KM-160.
12. Open the PR. In the body:
    - the Delete list;
    - the per-directory file counts;

    - the line `deletion-guard: needs an admin APPROVED review on head <sha>; reviewer approves and merges with admin override (KTD11)`.

## Test scenarios

- `scripts/check-boundaries.test.mjs`: the three rewritten tests pass with the stated expectations. `browser can consume contracts` and `invalid browser import makes the command fail for CI` still pass.
- `scripts/check-terminology.test.mjs`: every test passes with the new fixture paths. `invalid terminology makes the command fail for CI` still exits 1 on `packages/agent/src/help.ts`.
- `scripts/dist-exports.test.mjs`: the remaining `packages/messaging` case passes.
- Repository: `node scripts/check-boundaries.mjs` prints `Import boundaries passed.`; `node scripts/check-terminology.mjs` prints `Khala terminology passed.`
- `pnpm -r ls --depth -1 | grep -c "@aiur/khala"` prints `0`, and `node -p "require('./packages/agent/package.json').name"` prints `@khala/agent`.

## Risks and stop conditions

- **Stop** if any Step 1 precondition fails. Name the missing ticket.
- **Stop** if `pnpm typecheck` shows that kept code (`apps/web`, `apps/control`, `packages/agent`, `packages/contracts`, `packages/messaging`) imports a deleted package. That is a missed harvest or cut in KM-103, KM-120 or KM-123; report the importer and do not re-add the package.
- KM-111 and KM-112 (idle-wake spikes) harvest `packages/claude-plugin/hooks/` and `packages/harnesses/src/codex/idle-wake*.ts`. If either is still open, note in the PR body that their sources remain readable with `git show 5db209cc:<path>`. Do not delay this ticket.
- Do not delete `apps/internal/`, `experiments/` or anything under `docs/`.

## Complexity rationale

2: large by file count but mechanical. The judgment is limited to six small script edits whose outcomes are pinned by tests and preconditions.
